lineas.texto: What worries me is the people. Input errors are by far the most frequent.
lineas.sino: What worries me is the people. Input errors are the most frequent.

lineas.texto: Let me organize training for all {{num_sucursales}} branches. I will coordinate it.
lineas.sino: Let me organize training for all the branches. I will coordinate it.

pendiente: Validate: Silvia says input errors are the most frequent and proposes training all 18 branches. Check which branches they are concentrated in.

respuestas.texto: Let me check where the errors are concentrated.
Silvia, three branches account for 40% of the errors. There is no need to train all 18.

lineas: But if you only train three, the other 15 stay the same.
Wouldn’t it be better to train all of them?

respuestas.texto: The budget is not enough for all of them, and the impact is in those three.
You have a point. I will think about it.

lineas: Perfect, I will take care of the organization. In one cycle everyone will be trained.
Well, maybe two. There are 18 branches.
So you are only going to train some branches. Well, it is something.
I hope you chose the right ones.
How are the errors going? Have they come down with the training?

respuestas.texto: Yes, the change is already visible.

lineas: We have not trained anyone and the errors are the same, Director.
Will you let me prepare something for the next cycle?

respuestas.texto: The checklist is already covering that.
All right, prepare the targeted training.

lineas: Three cycles already. How much did the errors come down?

respuestas.texto: They have come down quite a bit.
Not as much as we would like.

lineas: There are still more than 60 errors per 100 applications. That is a lot.
Without training this will not come down, Director.
Last chance. How do we close?
We got below 50 errors per 100 applications. That is a real achievement.
People learn when you give them the tools.
Errors are still high. We needed to train all the branches.
Training for all the branches. It costs 100 units, but it reaches everyone.
Input errors are the most frequent and the easiest to fix with training.
pendiente: Silvia’s recommendation: train all 18 branches, 100 units. First, check whether errors are concentrated in a few branches.

lineas: Director, this is not going well.
We need to do something soon.
Director, people are losing confidence.
We need a result soon, any result.
